name: WRM-2456
description: WRM-2456, nicknamed Worm, was a protocol droid who served Thane Chulok in the city of New Xaxxis on the planet Metagos. He had a golden inverted pyramid body on treads. After Chulok's apparent defeat during Jedi Master Mace Windu's mission to Metagos, WRM-2456 offered to assist the surviving citizens.
